html: Online LLM selection and routing from limited user feedback, combining bandit learning, user studies and large-scale evaluation; humanoid robotics on the Unitree G1 and Go2, from teleoperation and demonstration collection to behavior cloning and policy evaluation.

With Dr. Jie Ying Wu: a GPT-style multimodal model fusing surgical video and kinematics to forecast robot end-effector trajectories (<5 mm RMSE one second ahead), and an AR surgical-training simulator that improved gesture recognition and skill assessment by 18%.
Fine-tuned GPT-2, Falcon, RWKV and CodeT5 for text-to-SQL with QLoRA, and built a reproducible benchmarking framework to compare data-efficient adaptation strategies.
With Dr. Shuguang Su: multimodal lung-disease diagnosis combining BERT on clinical text with ResNet-50 on chest imaging, reaching 0.91 micro-F1 and cutting diagnosis time by 90%.
